'''2008 New York State Championship Joe Giannetti DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joe Giannetti]] at [[2008 New York State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' I Noticed You Checkin' out The Goods
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS15]]
